title: Korean retailers follow tourist boom beyond Seoul
caption:
Major Korean retailers are shifting their focus away from Seoul as tourism in cities like Busan reaches record highs. By targeting regional hotspots, brands are racing to capture new spending power from international visitors.

Source: Koreaherald - Korean retailers follow tourist boom beyond Seoul
